function _emitPrimaryRevenueSettled(
        bytes32 key,
        PrimarySale calldata sale,
        address asset,
        SaleResolution memory resolution,
        bytes32 contextHash,
        bool policyDrift
    ) private {
        emit PrimaryRevenueSettled(
            key,
            sale.revenueClass,
            resolution.profileId,
            resolution.wallet,
            asset,
            sale.payer,
            sale.amount,
            contextHash,
            policyDrift,
            resolution.assignmentType
        );
    }

        bytes32 profileId,

            key,

            msg.sender,
            sale.settlementId,
            sale.policyMode,
            sale.collectionId,
            sale.tokenId,

            templateId
        );
